notes.title: GAME RELEASE - Hentai Killer: Girls & Chess
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the game was released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1507490/Hentai_Killer_Girls__Chess/

[b]Hentai Killer: Girls & Chess[/b] -  game in which you have to assemble your beautiful team of girls and put them on the battlefield in a strategic  autobattler.

We hope you like the game, and even if you don't, please leave your feedback and a review! The reviews are lifeblood for all the games on this platform, and we really need your support!
